decision: No new production design justified. Actual builtin module lookups already use PyModule.TryGetCachedMember, stabilizing factory results in the existing metadata cache; JSON default loads/dumps and short call packet bypasses already exist.
stalePlanCorrection: Local imports already compile ExecutableScript and run its Code synchronously/asynchronously since840621405. No later import consolidation project remains.
evidence: Both public API routes pass repeated independent attribute/getattr identity checks on all4JSON functions, aliases and budget reuse; CPython3.13.2 agrees.
PyModule.TryGetCachedMember checks existing cache before calling TryGetMember; JsonModuleCallable has readonly metadata, not per-record wrapper construction.
Existing ImportArchitectureSubsystemTests/PyModulePrimitiveTests cover module identity and mutable script namespace behavior.
avoided: Do not add four explicit JSON definitions behind an existing stable-definition cache or replace already stack-backed argument packets.
